data.exact_reserve_text: Claims incurred during the year, net of reinsurance, include adverse prior year development of GBP 8.7m (2016: GBP 0.7m favourable development).
data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2017 were GBP 111.871m. The report discloses adverse prior year development (net of reinsurance) of GBP 8.7m for the year, indicating an overall strengthening of reserves. No explicit gross prior year movement is provided in the notes in a single gross figure; the GBP 8.7m figure is reported net of reinsurance and has been used as a fallback. The report also attributes increases in technical provisions elsewhere to adverse catastrophe experience and increased IBNR provisioning.
raw_causal_phrases: adverse prior year development of GBP 8.7m (2016: GBP 0.7m favourable development).
this increase is driven by the adverse catastrophe experience and the provision of IBNR on the live business from additional premium.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (liabilities) - clear. A gross prior-year development (PYD) figure was not clearly presented as a single gross 'movement in prior years' in the notes; the report explicitly states an adverse prior year development of GBP 8.7m net of reinsurance and that net figure has been used as a fallback. A gross PYD could potentially be derived from the gross claims development table (page 38) but the triangle data in the scanned images was not reliably machine-extractable; therefore gross PYD is not reported. No discrete named catastrophe events with quantified impacts on prior years were found in the visible pages.
